name: All Url Uploader
description: Telegram bot that downloads direct URLs and supported yt-dlp media, then uploads the result back to Telegram.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram user ID that owns and administers the bot.

AUTH_USERS.description: Optional comma-separated Telegram user IDs that can bypass the cooldown.

DOWNLOAD_LOCATION.description: Writable path used for temporary downloads, uploads, requests, and thumbnails.

CHUNK_SIZE.description: Optional direct-download chunk size; values below 1024 are treated as kilobytes.

HTTP_PROXY.description: Optional proxy URL used for direct downloads, yt-dlp, and gallery-dl.

TELEGRAM_PROXY.description: Optional proxy URL for the Telegram API connection only; falls back to HTTP_PROXY when unset.

PROCESS_MAX_TIMEOUT.description: Optional timeout in seconds for external tool processes.

AUTO_BEST_QUALITY.description: Download best available quality without format selection prompts.

MAX_HEIGHT.description: Maximum video height for automatic best-quality downloads.

TWITTER_COOKIES.description: Optional inline Netscape cookies.txt content of a logged-in X account; enables 18+ (NSFW) post downloads.

TELEGRAM_API_URL.description: Optional base URL of a self-hosted local Bot API server; raises the bot upload limit from 50 MB to 2000 MB.
